Write an analysis as a reproducible project (paper architecture)

Source: R/analysis_project.R
write_analysis_project.Rd

Writes a folder organised like the repository of a published paper – scripts/ numbered (00_START, 01_DATA, 02_ANALYSIS, 03_FIGURE, 04_SUPP, 05_STAT), utils/, data/raw and data/processed, results/figures and results/tables, manuscript/, run_all.R, README.md, an RStudio project and .gitignore – then RUNS it: the tables, figures and the Methods & Results report (manuscript/ Methods_Results.docx) are produced by the project's own scripts, in a separate R process, from the raw landmarks written in data/raw. What the archive contains is therefore exactly what running it again gives.

Usage

write_analysis_project(
  landmarks,
  dir,
  params = analysis_params(),
  repeats = NULL,
  literature = NULL,
  title = "Morphological analyses",
  author = "",
  run = TRUE,
  zip = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

landmarks

An "intrait_landmarks" object (coordinates in pixels, metadata with at least species; site, date, operator, source used when present), e.g. from read_landmarks_xlsx(). May be NULL when literature is given (the analyses based on landmarks – shape, measurement error – are then left out).

dir

Folder to create (its name is the project name). Must not exist or be empty.

params

Analysis parameters, see analysis_params().

repeats

Optional "intrait_landmarks" object of repeated digitizations (metadata individual, operator, replicate), for the measurement-error script.

literature

Optional individual trait records without photographs (published data sets): a data.frame with species, the nine FISHMORPH ratios and optionally specimen_code, site, date, study_id. They enter every analysis based on the ratios, with the provenance "literature"; written in data/raw/traits_literature.csv.

title, author

Title of the project and author(s), written in the README, the script headers and the report.

run

Run the project (run_all.R) after writing it.

zip

Zip the folder (<dir>.zip, next to it).

quiet

No progress messages.

Value

A list: dir, zip (path or NULL), log (the run log), ok (TRUE when the run completed), error (message, when it did not).

See also

launch_intrait_analyses(), analysis_params()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
lm <- read_landmarks_xlsx("landmarks.xlsx", sheet = "measurements",
                          n_landmarks = 25, id_cols = "specimen")
res <- write_analysis_project(lm, "~/Desktop/T26_morphology",
                              params = analysis_params(min_n = 10),
                              title = "Morphology of the T26 fishes",
                              author = "A. Toussaint")
res$zip
} # }
